'''Anlen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He worked under [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Carness]].<ref name="TORHR" />
